data.one_liner: Detects if a user has an ad blocker or DNS-level adblocking enabled.
data.what_it_does: Checks if the device has a DNS-level adblocker, AdGuard DNS, or specific ad networks blocked by making network requests. Verifies internet connectivity before checking to prevent false positives.
use_when: You need to detect if users are blocking ads or analytics endpoints via DNS blockers or extensions.
You want to prompt users to whitelist your app or disable adblockers.
avoid_when: Your target audience is in regions where certain ad networks or test domains are entirely blocked (e.g. China).
You cannot tolerate false positives caused by temporary network drops.
strengths: Supports multiple built-in ad networks like Google AdMob and Media.net.
Allows custom ad network URIs and custom test hosts for connectivity checks.
Cross-platform support across mobile, web, and desktop.
weaknesses: Relies on network requests, which can fail or trigger false positives if connectivity fluctuates.
Certain test networks or hosts may be blocked in specific countries like China.
data.setup_notes: No complex native setup required. Uses standard HTTP requests.
data.minimal_example:
AdBlockDetector adBlockDetector = AdBlockDetector();
bool isAdblocking = await adBlockDetector.isAdBlockEnabled(testAdNetworks: [AdNetworks.googleAdMob]);
